entities.summary: Yekaterina Borisovna Altabayeva, is a Russian politician. Member of the Federation Council from the executive authority from Russian-controlled Sevastopol, since 2 October 2020, she also served as the member from the legislative authority of Sevastopol from 2019 to 2020.
